description: Render a scoped, cheap MOTION preview — ONLY body.fromSec→body.toSec of the composition (max 60s) at preview quality (capped resolution, lighter encode) through the real render pipeline. THE way to judge motion — a cut, a transition, a component's animation — at full fidelity BEFORE paying for a full render (a still cannot show motion; a full render costs the export). ASYNC: returns a render job; wait_job(kind="render", id=renderId) or a render.completed webhook for the URL. Meters the capture feature, never an exports credit.

compositionId.description: Target a specific composition; defaults to the project's active composition.

fromSec.description: Window start, seconds into the composition.

name: preview_clip

category.description: Failure taxonomy when status is `error`; null otherwise. `authoring` = deterministic defect in YOUR composition/request — fix it, retrying is futile; `transient` = temporary pipeline/infra failure — safe to retry_render; `internal` = unexpected server fault — retry once then escalate. Mirrors the render.failed webhook's `category`.

error.description: Human-readable failure message. Pair with `errorCode` for a stable, machine-readable code an agent runner can branch on.

errorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error code (e.g. `render_pipeline_unavailable`, `render_route_missing`, `render_pipeline_failed`). Null when status is not `error` or unavailable for an older render.

errorDetails.description: Structured failure context — `{ targetUrl?, upstreamStatus?, upstreamCode?, attemptedAt? }`. Surfaced so agent runners can distinguish operator-config issues from upstream-down vs route-missing without parsing `error`.

listUsd.description: A2 money stamp: the metered event's LIST price (USD), stamped at the success terminal (exports for deliverable renders, compose_capture for A8 previews). A plan allowance may zero the actual invoice line — this is the list price, never a Stripe charge. Absent while running, on failure, and for x402 orgs (on-chain receipts). Mirrors the get_usage ledger.

progress.description: Non-terminal render progress; phase is one of the worker's emitted stages.

retryable.description: Whether re-attempting the SAME render can succeed (status `error`); null otherwise. true → call retry_render. false → deterministic (category authoring/internal); fix the composition first — retry_render alone reproduces it. Mirrors the render.failed webhook's `retryable`.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the render's most recent progress update. Compute staleness = now − updatedAt to distinguish a wedged render from a slow one and decide whether to wait, cancel, or retry.

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisories surfaced at render-CREATE (omitted when none, and on GET — create-time only).
